main_text.l: Ab illo talis se regi ac duci

page.notes: The line "verum dirigunturin" has no printed space between "dirigunturin" and "usum", which is a printing error left as printed. "quiquè" is printed with a grave accent and is kept as printed. The word "hostis." at the end of the sixth-but-one line is slightly blurred and read as "hostis."; the reading is fairly certain. The last line is short, ending at the right margin with "possit," and the page continues there.
